name: decision-router
description: Picks the right Claude model for every message, so your plan lasts longer. A small decision model, on your own computer or a hosted service, rates each task: easy ones go to a lighter model, hard ones to a stronger one.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Watch only shows the picks. Switch models lets the router change models for you.

preference.title: Priority
preference.description: Save usage favors lighter models; Best answers favors stronger ones.

allow_fable.title: Use Fable
allow_fable.description: For the hardest tasks. May use extra usage credits. The switch in Status and settings changes this too; the latest change wins.

backend.title: Decision model
backend.description: The small model that rates each message. Your own server keeps messages on your machine.

local_url.title: Server address
local_url.description: For your own server. Leave empty if it runs on this computer.

local_api_key.title: Server key
local_api_key.description: Only if your server asks for one. Enter none to remove it.

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflare_account_id.description: Shown on the Workers AI page of your Cloudflare dashboard.

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflare_api_token.description: A token limited to Workers AI. Enter none to remove it.

decision_model.title: Model name (advanced)
decision_model.description: Only if your server runs several models.

timeout_ms.title: Wait time, ms (advanced)
timeout_ms.description: 0 uses the default: 2,500 for hosted services, 8,000 for your own server.
